snippet.title: Dr. Jekyll no Houma ga Toki (ジーキル博士の彷魔が刻) Famicom Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A beginning to end playthrough of Toho's 1988 Nintendo Famicom game, Jiikiru Hakase no Houma ga Toki (ジーキル博士の彷魔が刻), released in the US in 1989 by Bandai as "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde."

Though on the surface this game looks extremely similar to the American version, the levels are different (none of them repeat in the original), there are new enemies, and there are a lot more annoying obstacles, making this game significantly harder than the one that most American gamers loathe. Good luck if you attempt it. You'll probably loose some hair in the process. 

The game features no Japanese text but for the logo on the title screen. The characters read "Houma ga Toki."
